pages.text: Navyug Telematics Pvt Ltd designs and manufactures AIS-140 tracking devices at our factory in MIDC Bhosari, Pune. The NVT-140X supports GPS + NavIC (IRNSS) dual positioning. Connectivity: 4G LTE Cat-1 with 2G fallback. Built-in panic button with tamper alert. Enclosure rated IP67. Installation and service network across 22 states in India.

Orbitrack Devices Pvt Ltd manufactures the OT-4G-NV at our plant in Sector 63, Noida. OT-4G-NV offers NavIC and GPS tracking. 4G connectivity with automatic 2G fallback. Includes an SOS button for driver emergencies. Pan-India installation partners.
Sarathi Embedded Systems Pvt Ltd manufactures the SES-VT200 in IMT Manesar. GPS + NavIC, 4G, panic button, IP65 housing. Service across India.

Trackon Telematics Pvt Ltd manufactures the TT-AIS9 at Electronic City, Bengaluru. TT-AIS9 features GPS + NavIC positioning, 4G LTE with 2G fallback, an emergency button and an IP66 enclosure. Service centres in 15 states across India.
Trakon Telematics is a leading manufacturer of the TT-AIS9 AIS-140 tracker. GPS + NavIC, 4G LTE, panic button, IP67. Lowest prices in India.

RoadEye FleetOne (model KE-FleetOne) is manufactured for RoadEye by Kavach Electronics Pvt Ltd, Chennai. FleetOne supports GPS + NavIC, 4G with 2G fallback and a panic button. RoadEye provides installation and warranty service across India.

pages.text: FleetGuru Traders is an authorized dealer of multiple brands of GPS trackers. We resell AIS-140 devices with GPS + NavIC, 4G and panic button, IP67. Delivery across India.
